evidence.detail: Added TRAILBLAZER_CARD_PREVIEW_SIZE=12 limit, additional_trailblazer_card flag, and a 'Show all N...' toggle button in the person template
TRAILBLAZER_CARD_PREVIEW_SIZE = 12 caps the visible list to 12 cards
querySelectorAll('.trailblazer-card-list-toggle') JS wires up expand/collapse toggle so long lists are hidden behind a 'Show all N...' link
trailblazer-card-list-toggle link with aria-expanded and hidden attributes confirms the collapse UI is in place

triage.notes: The fix landed 2026-08-21, after bakert's comment about mouseover making the issue worse. The collapse/expand behavior is now present in the current master.
triage.proposed_comment: This was resolved in commit 360e9e44 ("Show seasons for cards played first"), which capped the Cards Played First section to 12 entries by default and added a JavaScript-powered "Show all N…" toggle for longer lists.
